sentences.en: You should struggle very hard to make this program work.
sentences.zh: 你应该努力使这个程序运行起来。

sentences.en: The man glanced at the news program and was shocked.
sentences.zh: 那人瞥了一眼新闻节目，感到震惊。

sentences.en: The show will be a great feature of tonight's program.
sentences.zh: 这将是今晚节目中的一大亮点。
